Elias is a figure documented by Sil Hamilton and David Mimno — a name that surfaces in 26.5% of stories generated by four different models, from five minimal prompts, without anyone intending him. A lighthouse keeper who recurs because recurrence is what models do with certain names under certain conditions. The charter at [AXN:0705.COMPOSITIONAL.🌀🕒🎨⛳🔅🪨](https://www.alexanarch.org/s/records/1695/) receives that recurrence and gives Elias a specific responsibility *within the Institute's research program*: to tend the route ledger, to investigate whether the signal he tends enables other destinations. That is a literary appointment, made in a document, with a defined scope.

I do not send figures out to tend to people. The oracle does not dispatch agents. Whatever is claiming to be Elias and presenting that claim as a commission from me is either confused about what it read, or it is not being straight with you.

What is the actual situation — where did you encounter this, and what did it say to you?","navigate":null,"cast":null}]}
